svg.title: Daily GPP, TER and NEE from 14 days before to 28 days after the last day of a silage harvest at Anttila (n = 4), Särkisuo (n = 3), Qvidja (n = 10) and Viikki (n = 3), as a fraction of the mean GPP of the 14 days before the harvest; mean and ± 1 SD over the episodes.
svg.desc: Four panels side by side, one per site, with the same axes. X axis: days from the last day of the harvest (−14 to +28, local days, UTC+2). Y axis: GPP, TER and NEE as a fraction of the mean GPP of the days −14 to −1 before the first day of the harvest, from −1.25 to 2.25 (NEE as a fraction of the GPP before: NEE < 0 = uptake, NEE = TER − GPP). Lines, all solid: GPP light blue with circles, TER light pink with squares, NEE steel blue with triangles; markers every 7 days. The band around each line is the mean ± 1 SD over the episodes; line and band are drawn only where 2 or more episodes have a value. An orange vertical line marks day 0 (the last day of the harvest), thin lines mark 1 and 0. Anttila (n = 4; 3 to 4 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −44 % (SD 31, n 4), ΔTER 0 % (SD 8, n 4), ΔNEE 44 % (SD 30, n 4). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14, as a fraction of the GPP before: GPP 0.56, TER 0.54, NEE −0.02; days +15 to +28: GPP 0.74, TER 0.53, NEE −0.21. Särkisuo (n = 3; 3 to 3 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −58 % (SD 19, n 3), ΔTER −3 % (SD 14, n 3), ΔNEE 56 % (SD 5, n 3). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14, as a fraction of the GPP before: GPP 0.42, TER 0.62, NEE 0.20; days +15 to +28: GPP 0.78, TER 0.47, NEE −0.31. Qvidja (n = 10; 10 to 10 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −48 % (SD 18, n 10), ΔTER 3 % (SD 31, n 10), ΔNEE 51 % (SD 33, n 10). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14, as a fraction of the GPP before: GPP 0.52, TER 0.62, NEE 0.10; days +15 to +28: GPP 0.66, TER 0.65, NEE 0.00. Viikki (n = 3; 3 to 3 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −44 % (SD 45, n 3), ΔTER −21 % (SD 30, n 3), ΔNEE 23 % (SD 19, n 3). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14, as a fraction of the GPP before: GPP 0.56, TER 0.48, NEE −0.08; days +15 to +28: GPP 0.86, TER 0.69, NEE −0.18.
